UPDATE order_outbox_events SET status = 'RETRY', retry_count = #{retryCount}, next_retry_at = #{nextRetryAt}, locked_at = NULL, last_error = #{lastError}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE id = #{eventId} AND status = 'PROCESSING'
